data.content_ref: inline:Abstraction: SRC_010's covering principle abstracts SRC_003, SRC_005, SRC_008, and SRC_009 into the single claim that every admissible strengthening of the grounded extension is a polynomial-time monotone edge enrichment before the fixpoint; refuted if any of the four foundations preserves validity by a mechanism that is not representable as monotone edge addition on non-committed-root nodes.
